record.context_brief: Riesz equilibrium measure on an annulus
record.original_question: Fix d - 2 < s < d and consider the annulus B_{r,R} = {x in R^d : r <= |x| <= R}. Find the equilibrium measure mu* supported on B_{r,R} that minimizes the Riesz s-energy I_s(mu) = integral integral K_s(x - y) dmu(x) dmu(y) among all probability measures supported on that annulus.

evidence.quote: For -2 < s < d, the Riesz energy of a probability measure mu on R^d is Is(mu) := integral integral Ks(x - y) dmu(x) dmu(y).

Equilibrium open problem for multi-dimensional annulus. Given d - 2 < s < d, find an equilibrium measure on an annulus B_{r,R} := {x in R^d : r <= |x| <= R}, i.e. the measure mu* such that mu* = arg min_{supp(mu) subset B_{r,R}} Is(mu).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d \ge 2$ be an integer and fix a parameter $s$ with $d-2 < s < d$. Define the Riesz $s$-kernel on $\mathbb{R}^d$ by
$$K_s(x-y) = \frac{1}{|x-y|^s} \quad (s \neq 0), \qquad K_0(x-y) = -\log|x-y|,$$
and for a Borel probability measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$ define its Riesz $s$-energy
$$I_s(\mu) = \iint K_s(x-y)\, d\mu(x)\, d\mu(y).$$
Given radii $0 < r < R < \infty$, let
$$B_{r,R} = \{ x \in \mathbb{R}^d : r \le |x| \le R \}$$
be the closed annulus in $\mathbb{R}^d$. Determine explicitly the equilibrium measure $\mu^*$, i.e. the probability measure supported in $B_{r,R}$ that achieves
$$\mu^* = \arg\min_{\mu : \, \operatorname{supp}(\mu) \subseteq B_{r,R}} I_s(\mu),$$
where the minimum is taken over Borel probability measures supported on $B_{r,R}$. In particular, identify the support of $\mu^*$ and give a closed-form expression (or density) for $\mu^*$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature on Riesz equilibrium problems indicates that while equilibrium measures on balls and certain shells (with external fields) have been characterized in some specific parameter regimes, an explicit description of the unweighted Riesz $s$-equilibrium measure on a multi-dimensional annulus for the full range $d-2 < s < d$ remains unresolved. Surveys note that even when the support is known to fill the annulus, an explicit density is unknown.

status_evidence.title: Equilibrium measures for higher dimensional rotationally symmetric Riesz gases
status_evidence.snippet: Characterises confining potentials for which the equilibrium measure is supported on the unit ball; does not give an explicit measure for the unweighted annulus problem.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work treats related ball-support cases but does not resolve the annulus equilibrium problem.

status_evidence.title: Threshold condensation to singular support for a Riesz equilibrium problem
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Riesz equilibrium with external fields; mentions that for strictly subharmonic Riesz kernels (max(0,d-2)<s<d) the equilibrium measure of a shell occupies the whole shell but an explicit density is unknown.
status_evidence.claim: The explicit form of the equilibrium density on an annulus remains unknown in the relevant range.
